name: QTS Calatorao data center campus
summary: Blackstone, through its data center company QTS, proposes a 224-hectare data center campus on industrial land beside the A-2 motorway near Calatorao in Zaragoza province, Aragon. Announced in October 2024 at up to EUR 7.5 billion and reported at 300 MW of electrical capacity at full build-out, it received a regional general-interest declaration (DIGA) in October 2024 and initial approval of its regional general-interest plan (PIGA) in August 2025. QTS describes it as a proposed development and has not published a construction schedule.

location.note: Nominatim centroid of the municipality of Calatorao; sources place the site on industrial land beside the A-2 about 7 km from the town centre, without a parcel.

parties.name: Blackstone
parties.note: Funds managed by Blackstone affiliates finance the project; QTS is a Blackstone portfolio company.

parties.name: Gobierno de Aragón
parties.note: Granted the DIGA declaration and the initial PIGA approval.

metrics.note: Investment Monitor, citing Reuters, reported that half the site would be developed first and a further EUR 7.5 billion invested later for the remainder; that second tranche is not added here.
Reported electrical capacity when fully operational; not confirmed on the QTS page.

milestones.note: Aragon's cabinet approved a declaration of regional general interest (DIGA), starting the planning process.
Initial (not final) approval of the regional general-interest plan (PIGA), published in the Boletín Oficial de Aragón in late August 2025.

notes: Aragon cites up to 1,400 direct jobs in technology, construction and other sectors, and QTS about 1,400 direct plus up to 2,000 indirect jobs; these are not split by phase, so no jobs metric is recorded. No 2026 status update could be found; QTS's undated pages describe a proposed development worth several billion euros.
